## Description

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Include the PaperWeave version, Python version, operating system, input format,
command, and the smallest input that demonstrates the problem. Do not attach
copyrighted papers or secrets.

## Logs

Paste a relevant error or a redacted `manifests/last_run.json` excerpt.
